minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  February 28, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, February 28,
2019, at 2:02 pm in the City Council Community Room A, 1st Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer
  Aisha Thompson, Deputy City Clerk
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department
  Serena Martinez, Finance Department

Also Present: Joi Aldridge, Management Assistant, Public Works Department and
Angela Williams, Sanitation Services Manager, Public Works Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting and special
meeting both held, February 14, 2019. Minutes from the meetings on January 24 and
special meeting, January 31, 2019 were not included in the packet. Motion carried
approved, City Clerk abstained.

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  City of Inglewood, Public Works Department to host 2019 Earth Day
  Festival at City Hall, South Mall, April 20, 2019, from 10:00 am – 6:00 pm,
  subject to contacting Los Angeles County Fire Department (LACO FD),
  Inglewood Battalion Chief to discuss LACO FD staffing; Police staffing (1
  Sergeant, 6 Officers, 4 Traffic Control Officers); Traffic Control Officers
  (TCO’s) on location to ensure public safety and assist with road closures
  and effective flow of traffic on Queen St., Grevillea Ave., and surrounding
  areas, specifically where food trucks are operating; maintain safe and
  secure crowd control; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; adhere to all applicable IMC
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00273747)

  Present: Joi Aldridge, Management Assistant, Public Works Department
  Angela Williams, Sanitation Services Manager, Public Works
  Department
 Permits & License Committee  February 28, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

Item #2:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  City of Inglewood, Public Works Department to host E-Waste, Document
  Shredding and Donations Community Recycling Event at Grevillea Ave.
  and Manchester Blvd., March 15, June 22 and September 28, 2019, from
  9:00 am – 1:00 pm, subject to four (4) TCO’s to ensure public safety and
  assist with road closures and effective flow of traffic; Inglewood Police
  Department will provide extra patrol as time permits; maintain safe and
  secure crowd control; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; adhere to all applicable IMC
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00273749)

  Present: Joi Aldridge, Management Assistant, Public Works Department
  Angela Williams, Sanitation Services Manager, Public Works
  Department

Item #3:  Following discussion, the Permits & License (P&L) Committee came to a
  general consensus to allow Mr. Jakim Stewart to modify the P&L Special
  Event Application date from March 2, 2019, from 7:00 pm – 11:00 pm, and
  March 3, 2019, from 2:00 pm – 8:00 pm, to March 16, 2019, from 7:00 pm
  – 11:00 pm, and March 17, 2019, from 2:00 pm -8:00 pm, due to weather
  conditions forecasted for the weekend of March 2-3, 2019. Mr. Stewart
  also informed the P&L Committee that, Sunday, March 17, 2019, there will
  be two (2) outside bars, set-up behind the business structure with an
  enclosure consisting of pipe and drape (6 ft. x 8 in.)

  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Jakim Stewart; dba: Dobe Stogies to host their 2 Year Anniversary
  Celebration at 1322 N. La Brea Ave., March 16, 2019, from 7:00 pm – 11:00
  pm, and March 17, 2019, from 2:00 pm – 8:00 pm, subject to maintaining
  safe and secure crowd control; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; hiring a minimum of
  five (5) licensed security guards from a professional security guard
  company that holds a valid and current City of Inglewood business license;
  at least one (1) security guard is required to be assigned to each bar area
  to manage crowd control, check for proper identification to prevent
  underage drinking and maintain safety of attendees throughout the
  duration of the event; business owner is responsible for obtaining a valid
  one (1) day Alcohol Beverage Control license; placement of amplified
  equipment shall be designed to mitigate and minimize the noise level,
  impacting neighboring residents; outside music must end at 10:00 pm;
  responsible for ensuring all patrons maintain orderly conduct and keep
  event site clear of littering, loitering, and noise level should be kept to a
  minimum; Inglewood Police Department, Watch Commander will be
  notified and provide extra patrol as time permits; ensure safe pedestrian
  and vehicular circulation on/off site; adhere to all applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage, local,
  state and federal laws. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00273793)
 Permits & License Committee  February 28, 2019
Minutes  Page 3 of 4

  Present: Jakim Stewart, Owner, Drobe Stogies
Item #4:  Mr. William Steve Garcia, addressed the P&L Committee, requesting to
  add suite number 211, to his business license application. Mr. Garcia also
  informed the P&L Committee that all sales transactions for new and used
  vehicles is conducted via internet/online only. Vehicles are stored in Van
  Nuys, California and delivered to the buyer.

  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for William Steve Garcia; dba: Will’s SOS Auto to operate as a
  new and used auto broker (office use only); subject to annual payment of
  business license and tax; Los Angeles County Fire Department field
  inspection; an expired or lapsed license for more than six months will
  negatively impact your business license renewal; parking and/or
  advertising vehicles for sale , vehicle repairs and/or maintenance on city
  streets, sidewalks, or alleys is strictly prohibited and violators will be towed
  at owners expense; applicant and all employees selling vehicles shall be
  registered and/or licensed to sell vehicles with the California Department
  of Motor Vehicles; social gatherings, special events and/or alcoholic
  beverages is strictly prohibited on site; adhere to all applicable IMC rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00273417)

  Present: William Steve Garcia, Owner, Wills SOS Auto

Item #5:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for La Toyoa Caswell; dba: Tresses by Toy to operate a beauty
  salon at 2910 W. Manchester Blvd., Monday – Saturday, from 6:00 am –
  10:00 pm, subject to payment of annual business license and tax; Los
  Angeles County Fire Department field inspection; business owner must
  possess and maintain a valid and current State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology, Establishment License; submit copy of establishment
  license to the Finance department; booth renters and/or independent
  contractors operating within the establishment must possess applicable
  licenses from the State Board of Barbering and Cosmetology, register and
  file business taxes with the City; parties and/or events are not permitted
  inside or outside the location; loitering and consumption of alcoholic
  beverages is not permitted on the premises; massage therapy of any part
  of the body is not permitted; disrobing is not permitted, patrons must remain
  fully clothed while receiving salon services; adhere to all applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00273439)

Item #6:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for Anthony Norman; dba: Royalty Barbers & Grooming to operate
  a barbering and grooming establishment at 8620 Crenshaw Blvd.,
  Tuesday-Saturday, from 9:00 am – 7:00 pm, subject to payment of annual
  business license and tax; Los Angeles County Fire Department field
  inspection; business owner must possess and maintain a valid and current
  State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology, Establishment License; submit
  copy of establishment license to the Finance department; booth renters
  and/or independent contractors operating within the establishment must
 Permits & License Committee  February 28, 2019

  possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering and
  Cosmetology, register and file business taxes with the City; parties and/or
  events are not permitted inside or outside the location; loitering and
  consumption of alcoholic beverages is not permitted on the premises;
  massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted; disrobing is not
  permitted, patrons must remain fully clothed while receiving salon services;
  adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00273666)
  Present: Tony Roman, Owner, Royalty Barbers & Grooming

Item #7:  Top Line Quality Service, Inc; dba; Best Yet Transportation to operate a
  shuttle service within the City, Committee recommended item be held-over
  to give the applicant additional time to provide supplemental documents (1)
  List of Corporate Officers (2) List of facilities, hospitals and/or businesses
  contracted with to provide services (3) Clarify type of shuttle service your
  business is operating (4) Fictitious business name statement recorded with
  the Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk Office (5)
  California Highway Patrol inspection reports and certifications for each
  vehicle (if operating an emergency and/or non-emergency transportation)
  (6) Transportation Charter Permit (TCP) License (if operating a shuttle
  service) (7) List naming employee’s operating in the City with their
  California Driver’s License and Certifications. (Activity No. 00273658)

Item #8:  Daniel Kash; dba: L.A.X. Firing Range, Inc. to operate a firing range at 927
  W. Manchester Blvd., Committee recommended item be held-over to notify
  Daniel Kash that his attendance at the Permits & License Committee
  meeting is mandatory. (Activity No. 00249810)

  Present: Monique Kash, Manager, LAX Firing Range

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:31 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
